description:
Three tracked survey-harness lockfiles do not match their manifests: `cargo metadata --locked` fails with `cannot update the lock file` for `19513245/survey/field-laws`, `4e732b56/baseline-survey/gf2-side` and `6c6b09b1/survey/field-laws` under `dev/active/`.

## Background

The control section of the harness path-dependency trial output linked to the documentation-overhaul epic lists the status of every tracked lockfile.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Every tracked harness lockfile resolves under `--locked` on Rust 1.95.
- [hard] REQ-02: Lockfiles that a committed receipt pins by digest keep their bytes; a pinned stale lockfile is listed with its pinning receipt in a linked record.
title: Three tracked harness lockfiles fail --locked resolution
